column1: # The words and the forms of the language that the formats before 2.23 had and 2.23 does not: lang (ru, en), kind, the former word, what is written now, the label of the change (AL-NN), how the former form is shown in a message.

# The code never writes such a word itself (it asks `former_find`), so the sources hold no Cyrillic word of the structure. There is no transition period (the owner, 2026-10-20): a former form is an error with the new form to write.
# The column `was` is the format that still had the form; empty means 2.22. The forms that 2.24 removed have 2.23. The kind `section` is the heading of a section: the word is the title without `## `.
